'''Edgar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was stationed at the [[Talus Imperial Outpost|Imperial Outpost]] on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG:SK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Edgar appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Officer Edgar was intended to be the Imperial quest giver for the fifth and final chapter of the story arc "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]". This chapter was achieving its development in [[October]] [[2005]]<ref name="ID">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=In%20Development|text=In Development}}</ref> but was delayed and planned to be introduced in [[April]] [[2006]] with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]."<ref name="P28">{{WebCite|url=https://forums.mmorpg.com/discussion/72650/pub-28-notes|text=Pub 28 Notes|date=2006-03-31|nobackup=1}}</ref> Officer Edgar and [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]], the Rebel quest giver, were both added to the game with the Publish 28, released on [[April 26]], 2006.<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> Nevertheless, the final chapter of "Secrets of the Syren" was never released and these NPCs did not provide any quest.<ref name="SWG:SK" />
